title: Hospital Beds & Support Surfaces — Pickup Lead Time and Equipment Recovery Charges
content:
Hospital Beds & Support Surfaces pickup and recovery values, by bed class: the business days after a confirmed return within which the bed is picked up; the calendar days after the confirmed pickup date after which a rented bed still not recovered is charged; the charge for a rented bed not recovered; and the charge for a rented bed recovered damaged beyond normal wear (US dollars).

| Bed class | Pickup within (business days after a confirmed return) | Calendar days after the confirmed pickup date | Charge for a rented bed not recovered | Charge for a rented bed recovered damaged beyond normal wear |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Fixed-Height Hospital Bed (E0250) | 3 | 30 | $950.00 | $150.00 |
| Variable-Height Hospital Bed (E0255) | 3 | 30 | $1100.00 | $150.00 |
| Semi-Electric Hospital Bed (E0260) | 3 | 30 | $1250.00 | $200.00 |
| Total Electric Hospital Bed (E0265) | 3 | 30 | $1650.00 | $200.00 |
| Heavy-Duty Hospital Bed (E0303) | 3 | 30 | $2200.00 | $300.00 |
| Extra Heavy-Duty Hospital Bed (E0304) | 3 | 30 | $5800.00 | $500.00 |

## Schedule notes

1. Pickup lead: 3 business days after a confirmed return, in every class.
2. Unrecovered beds: the period is 30 calendar days after the confirmed pickup date in every class; the charge for a rented bed not recovered varies by class, from $950.00 (E0250) to $5800.00 (E0304).
3. Damage beyond normal wear: $150.00 for the Fixed-Height and Variable-Height classes, $200.00 for the Semi-Electric and Total Electric classes, $300.00 for the Heavy-Duty class and $500.00 for the Extra Heavy-Duty class.
